summary: The closure-area identities are valid, all sets used in Brunn--Minkowski are bounded measurable convex sets of positive area, both Brunn--Minkowski applications have the correct scaling, and accepted fact c472ceb412ca0594 applies with exactly matching hypotheses to give the strict endpoint separation and positive slab area. The three charged subsets are exactly pairwise disjoint and lie in the full midpoint set. Convexity gives H contained in A_2, hence the midpoint set is contained in K, and the positive slab term yields the claimed strict inequality. No unsupported dependency is used beyond the supplied accepted predecessor facts.
